mapper.select: SELECT id, file_path, file_size, file_mtime FROM song WHERE file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{rootPath}, '%')
SELECT id, file_path FROM song WHERE file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{rootPath}, '%') ORDER BY id LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT id, file_path, file_size, file_mtime FROM song WHERE
file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{dir}, '%')

SELECT file_hash AS hash, LISTAGG(file_path, '||') AS paths, LISTAGG(file_name, '||') AS names, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM song WHERE file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{rootPath}, '%') GROUP BY file_hash HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT file_hash AS hash, GROUP_CONCAT(file_path SEPARATOR '||') AS paths, GROUP_CONCAT(file_name SEPARATOR '||') AS names, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM song WHERE file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{rootPath}, '%') GROUP BY file_hash HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT file_name AS name, LISTAGG(file_path, '||') AS paths, LISTAGG(file_name, '||') AS names, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM song WHERE
file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{p}, '%')
GROUP BY file_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT file_name AS name, GROUP_CONCAT(file_path SEPARATOR '||') AS paths, GROUP_CONCAT(file_name SEPARATOR '||') AS names, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM song WHERE
file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{p}, '%')
GROUP BY file_name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1

SELECT s.file_path AS filePath, s.file_name AS fileName, s.title, s.duration, al.album_name AS albumName, LISTAGG(a.artist_name, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sa.sort_order, a.id) AS artistNames FROM song s LEFT JOIN album al ON s.album_id = al.id LEFT JOIN song_artist sa ON s.id = sa.song_id LEFT JOIN artist a ON sa.artist_id = a.id WHERE
s.file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{p}, '%')
GROUP BY s.id

SELECT s.file_path AS filePath, s.file_name AS fileName, s.title, s.duration, al.album_name AS albumName, GROUP_CONCAT(a.artist_name ORDER BY sa.sort_order, a.id SEPARATOR ',') AS artistNames FROM song s LEFT JOIN album al ON s.album_id = al.id LEFT JOIN song_artist sa ON s.id = sa.song_id LEFT JOIN artist a ON sa.artist_id = a.id WHERE
s.file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{p}, '%')
GROUP BY s.id
SELECT file_path AS filePath, file_name AS fileName, fingerprint, duration FROM song WHERE file_path LIKE CONCAT(#{rootPath}, '%') AND fingerprint IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id
